note: Designed (M4 milestone B, revised 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25). The AI takes the legal player with the highest score, ties by player id: with v = positionValue x the style's value (1 where the style lists none), score = v x overall + the style's need (1 unless stated) x slotNeed for the slot he would fill + v x error. valueCurve: at a listed position the style's value x the curve at his overall replaces v x overall (straight lines between the points); positionValue there only scales the misreading. slotNeed: one bonus in score points per roster slot up to the position's target, never rising, 0 from the target on. error: the team's fixed misreading of the player's overall, errorSd x a seeded normal, with errorSd drawn per team uniformly from evaluation. styles: each AI team draws one by weight. autoPick: the profile the user's auto-pick and auto-draft use. Kickers and punters (2026-11-25, Joseph: special kickers can go earlier): the curve is flat to 89 and jumps at 90, so with the slotNeed bonus an ordinary one waits until about round 25 and one of 90 or more goes from about round 4 to 10; with no bonus a second one is worth less than any late pick. bestPlayer halves the bonus, so its K and P value is 1.3. Quarterbacks (2026-11-25): positionValue 0.92 with a large bonus for the first two slots, so every team takes two and a third and fourth are worth less than a player of the same overall elsewhere. Tuning: every number is set by hand, on simulated leagues only, against the B13, B14, B17 and B18 readings that node --import ./scripts/engine/register.mjs scripts/franchise/tune-draft-ai.ts prints for this file over franchise seeds 100001 to 100800; that command checks them. The K, P and QB numbers were set with it on 2026-11-25 (candidates read on the first 96 to 800 of those seeds). The other numbers were set by hand on 2026-11-24 and that search was not recorded. A change here needs a re-tune of pool.json.
